name: Make a Army! ⚔️
desc:
Welcome to Make a Army! ⚔️

Are you ready to build the biggest army? Place troops in strategic designs, and click attack! Upgrade your troops and level up your design!

🛠️ Place your troops with strategy!
💥 Click attack to launch your raid!
💪 Unlock new troops that have special abilities

⏰ Remember, your army attacks offline! 🤑
